ruleDefinitions.name: New Sudoers Account Creation Linux
ruleDefinitions.description: This rule detects attempts to create a new Sudoers account. This could be indicative of an attacker trying to gain persistent, high-privilege access to the system.

sequences.query: activity_type:"process-create" AND ( process_command_line:RGXi("(/etc/sudoers|/etc/sudoers\\.d/)")   AND ( process_command_line:RGXi(">>|> ") OR process_command_line:RGXi("tee ") OR process_command_line:RGXi("visudo") OR process_command_line:RGXi("sed ")  OR process_command_line:RGXi("nano ")   OR process_command_line:RGXi("vi ")    OR process_command_line:RGXi("vim ") )) AND NOT user="root" AND NOT parent_process_name:("puppet","chef","ansible","salt","cloud-init")
